legal.sectionMedicalBody: Scores and assessments in this app (including the 5K time trial and other fitness tests) are for personal logging and leaderboard use only. They are not medical diagnosis, prescribing information, or emergency care guidance.
legal.sectionRiskBody: Assess your condition before intense training. Stop immediately if you feel unwell and seek professional medical care. You remain responsible for your training decisions and any physical risk that follows.
legal.sectionServiceBody: By signing in or continuing, you agree to use assessments, the ladder, and local features under the product rules. We may request renewed consent when these terms are updated.
